# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: multi-tier-app
description: Production-grade Helm chart for multi-tier application
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
replicaCount: 3
imagePullSecrets: []
frontend:
  image: nginx:1.25
  port: 80
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 100m
      memory: 128Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 500m
      memory: 512Mi
backend:
  image: your-registry/backend:1.0
  port: 8080
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 200m
      memory: 256Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 1000m
      memory: 1Gi
postgres:
  image: postgres:15-alpine
  port: 5432
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: 250m
      memory: 512Mi
    limits:
      cpu: 2000m
      memory: 2Gi
  storageSize: 10Gi
  storageClass: standard
secrets:
  dbUser: postgres
  dbPassword: change-me-in-production
  dbName: appdb
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
data:
  NGINX_PORT: "{{ .Values.frontend.port }}"
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-backend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
data:
  APP_PORT: "{{ .Values.backend.port }}"
  DB_HOST: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres
  DB_PORT: "{{ .Values.postgres.port }}"
  DB_NAME: {{ .Values.secrets.dbName }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-postgres.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-config
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
data:
  POSTGRES_DB: {{ .Values.secrets.dbName }}
---
# FILE: templates/secret.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db-secret
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_USER: {{ .Values.secrets.dbUser }}
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{ .Values.secrets.dbPassword }}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    tier: frontend
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
      tier: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
        tier: frontend
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets: {{ toYaml .Values.imagePullSecrets | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: {{ .Values.frontend.image }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.frontend.port }}
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend-config
          resources: {{ toYaml .Values.frontend.resources | nindent 12 }}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment-backend.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    tier: backend
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.replicaCount }}
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
      tier: backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
        tier: backend
    spec:
      imagePullSecrets: {{ toYaml .Values.imagePullSecrets | nindent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: backend
          image: {{ .Values.backend.image }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.backend.port }}
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-backend-config
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db-secret
          resources: {{ toYaml .Values.backend.resources | nindent 12 }}
---
# FILE: templates/statefulset-postgres.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    tier: database
spec:
  serviceName: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
      tier: database
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
        tier: database
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: {{ .Values.postgres.image }}
          ports:
            - containerPort: {{ .Values.postgres.port }}
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-postgres-config
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Release.Name }}-db-secret
          volumeMounts:
            - name: postgres-data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
          resources: {{ toYaml .Values.postgres.resources | nindent 12 }}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: postgres-data
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.postgres.storageClass }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.postgres.storageSize }}
---
# FILE: templates/service-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ .Release.Name }}-frontend
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    tier: frontend
spec:

    tier: frontend
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.frontend.port }}
      targetPort: {{ .Values.frontend.port }}
---

  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    tier: backend
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: {{ .Release.Name }}
    tier: backend
  ports:
    - port: {{ .Values.backend.port }}
      targetPort: {{ .Values.backend.port }}
